The queue size, poll interval, and submit rate fields specify how many jobs can be run at once,
how frequently Nextflow checks for job termination, and how quickly new jobs can be submitted.
These fields are optional, since Nextflow has built-in defaults for these values. Consult the
Nextflow documentation for further details on these default values.
